label: Each distinct dependence edge has a strict-step path in the selected PLG assumptions
paraphrase: OPEN formal bridge on the supplied dependence relation, labels and assumptions. For each distinct pair with D(x,y), the selected set contains antecedent-to-consequent steps making a finite path from the label of y to the label of x. At least one step comes from a strict full or partial sequent. The labels have no encoded metaphysical interpretation.
